title: Guideline on Sharing Guest Payments on HostCover Property-Damage Claims by Level
content:
**Host Damage Protection (HostCover) property-damage claims.** The property recovery-sharing method follows the plan level and decides how the guest payments recorded on the claim, net of reversals, are shared between Roamhaven and the host.

1. On HostCover Premier, HostCover Elite or HostCover Estate the guest payments first restore the deductible the property claim bears, so only the larger of those payments and that deductible is subtracted from the adjusted property loss.
2. On HostCover Standard or HostCover Plus the guest payments are shared in proportion to the parts of the loss each side bears, so that deductible is subtracted from the adjusted property loss together with the guest payments multiplied by the adjusted property loss less that deductible (never below 0.00) and divided by the adjusted property loss.
3. On any other level (HostCover Essential) the guest payments and that deductible are both subtracted from the adjusted property loss.

Terms: the **adjusted property loss** is the property loss being settled, before guest payments and the deductible come off it; the **guest payments** are those recorded on the property-damage claim less reversals; the **deductible** is the one the property claim bears.

## Worked example (hypothetical: adjusted property loss 1000.00, guest payments 400.00, deductible 200.00)

| Level | Subtracted | Left |
|---|---|---|
| HostCover Premier, Elite or Estate | the larger of 400.00 and 200.00: 400.00 | 600.00 |
| HostCover Standard or Plus | 200.00 plus 400.00 multiplied by 800.00 and divided by 1000.00 (320.00): 520.00 | 480.00 |
| HostCover Essential | 400.00 plus 200.00: 600.00 | 400.00 |

When the deductible is at least the adjusted property loss, the Standard and Plus proportion is taken on 0.00, so only the deductible is subtracted on those levels.
